crap.note: CRAP = complexity² × (1 − coverage)³ + complexity. Above 30 the function is a refactor-or-test target. Unmeasured coverage is treated as 0.

assertions.note: ASR is substantive assertions divided by all assertions. Tautologies (x == x, assert True) and type-or-presence checks are not substantive. A comparison against a literal is substantive and can still be a magic-number smell.

authenticity.note: DAR = verified imports / imports. Verified means stdlib, a module in this workspace, or a name declared in a manifest. No registry was contacted.

flakiness.note: FIRI = tests with direct time, random, filesystem, or network calls, divided by test functions. This does not re-run the suite.

audit.note: Authenticity scorecard is not the Merge Readiness Score and does not move the gate. DAR checks the workspace, the stdlib, and declared manifests. It does not query a package registry. FIRI is a static scan, not a reproduction of a flake.
